newsitem.title: USA: Motorola Q1 seen up from Q4, lower than year ago.
newsitem.headline: Motorola Q1 seen up from Q4, lower than year ago.

text.p: Motorola Inc is expected to report Monday that its first quarter earnings improved over the 1996 fourth quarter but fell below the 1996 first quarter due to a downturn in the semiconductor business, analysts said.
They said the growth in earnings from the 1996 fourth quarter is a sign that Motorola's other businesses, such as cellular phone infrastructure, are holding up.
"Generally, semiconductor industry sales are down...and that's going to be the big driver in lower earnings year-over-year," said Robert Wilkes, an analyst for Brown Brothers Harriman.
According to First Call, the consensus of analysts' earnings estimates for the first quarter is $0.45 a share.
Motorola earned $0.63 a share in the year-ago first quarter, $0.39 in the 1996 fourth quarter, and $0.34 in the 1996 third quarter.
